# How much do LinkedIn ads cost?

LinkedIn can help you achieve your marketing goals

![](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:5af307ff-e574-4a2d-94a3-df2aba0e1a0e/as/Mobileportrait_@1x.png?width=640&preferwebp=true)

![](/advertise/ads/pricing/_jcr_content/root/container_1593200375/container/image_1256694728.coreimg.png/1771452856718/mobileportrait--1x.png)

## Your LinkedIn advertising costs are based on the type of activity you're paying for and the ad auction.

![Illustration of bidding options for campaign spending on a computer screen.](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:fbf7c97b-aa6f-4ca7-b31a-79b353c6806b/as/Laptop.svg?width=640&preferwebp=true)

![](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:38cf2403-1c9b-4bef-ba1c-a1357ef458de/as/Bid_Icon1x.png?width=640&preferwebp=true)

You'll start your campaign by [placing a bid](https://www.linkedin.com/help/lms/answer/1392/campaign-bid-types-overview?src=direct%2Fnone&veh=direct%2Fnone%7Cdirect%2Fnone "placing a bid") when you launch your campaign.

![](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:56c37013-d567-40c1-99b4-71f44c825a42/as/Auction_Iconv1.png?width=640&preferwebp=true)

LinkedIn ads are sold through the [ad auction](https://www.linkedin.com/help/lms/answer/7431?src=direct%2Fnone&veh=direct%2Fnone "ad auction"), where your bid competes with other advertisers who want to reach the same target audience.

![](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:977ab707-e303-4ae2-bc0a-5c697f7454bd/as/Audience_Iconv1.png?width=640&preferwebp=true)

The target audience is made up of the LinkedIn members you're trying to reach with the ad campaign. The cost required to win the auction depends on the bid and the desirability of your [target audience](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/722?src=direct%2Fnone&veh=direct%2Fnone "target audience").

![](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:fbf7c97b-aa6f-4ca7-b31a-79b353c6806b/as/Laptop.svg?width=640&preferwebp=true)

![Illustration of a laptop with a mouse cursor choosing an option on screen](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:3656f2fd-7e42-4eb7-aa68-34782479a97f/as/Laptop_2.svg?width=640&preferwebp=true)

### Billable events

LinkedIn uses [objective-based pricing](https://www.linkedin.com/help/lms/answer/103969?src=direct%2Fnone&veh=direct%2Fnone "objective-based pricing"). What you'll be charged for depends on the campaign objective you choose. For example, when you choose the Website Visit Objective, you'll only be charged when someone clicks the link to your website. Each campaign objective has a different billable event, and you’re only charged when that event occurs. In other words, billable events are what you're charged for.

![Illustration of a finger tapping on the campaign objective "Awareness". "Consideration" and "Conversion" are the other two options listed](https://delivery-p143253-e1476319.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:073af6a8-e247-4424-bca8-c820ecbcdd67/as/Tablet_Icon.svg?width=640&preferwebp=true)

# LinkedIn ads for small business: costs, budgets and whether they are worth it

LinkedIn ads for small business: 2026 costs, minimum budgets, when they pay off for B2B and how to run a first campaign without wasting money.

![Mohsin Rashid](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F2n9frivv%2Fproduction%2F7d87ec4275544f24ce964e55ed093694ee39089c-2000x2000.png%3Fw%3D128%26h%3D128%26q%3D90%26auto%3Dformat&w=64&q=75)

By Mohsin Rashid·Oct 31, 2026·Updated Oct 31, 2026·3 min read

![Headline reading "Are LinkedIn ads worth it?" with "worth it" selected and tagged B2B, on a dark slate gradient](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F2n9frivv%2Fproduction%2Fbc006c9b7b32dafa8d175a30bb8c0aee2e1e6a9e-3200x2000.jpg%3Frect%3D0%2C100%2C3200%2C1800%26w%3D2400%26h%3D1350%26q%3D90%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=90)

Share[LinkedIn (opens in a new tab)](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.clarieo.com%2Finsights%2Flinkedin-ads-for-small-business)[X (opens in a new tab)](https://x.com/intent/post?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.clarieo.com%2Finsights%2Flinkedin-ads-for-small-business&text=LinkedIn%20ads%20for%20small%20business%3A%20costs%2C%20budgets%20and%20whether%20they%20are%20worth%20it)[Email](mailto:?subject=LinkedIn%20ads%20for%20small%20business%3A%20costs%2C%20budgets%20and%20whether%20they%20are%20worth%20it&body=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.clarieo.com%2Finsights%2Flinkedin-ads-for-small-business)

LinkedIn ads let you reach people by job title, company and industry, which no other ad platform does as precisely. That precision is expensive. Here is what LinkedIn ads cost in 2026, when they are worth it for a small business and how to run a first campaign that teaches you something.

## Key takeaways

01

LinkedIn ads suit B2B businesses with high customer value, not low-cost consumer products.

02

LinkedIn's minimum is $10 a day, but most clicks cost over $10, so tiny budgets learn very little.

03

A 2026 study of 211 B2B advertisers found median CPCs of about $13 for single image ads.

04

Start with one offer, one tight audience, Lead Gen Forms and a 30-day test before you scale.

01

## Are LinkedIn ads worth it for a small business?

They can be, if you sell to other businesses and one new client is worth thousands. For most consumer businesses they are not.

![A chat answer saying LinkedIn ads suit businesses selling to other businesses with valuable deals](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F2n9frivv%2Fproduction%2F2cc59b766cccfbfc47acc7bee3c3cb70f8babcbe-2800x1750.jpg%3Fw%3D1400%26q%3D90%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

LinkedIn's advantage is targeting. You can show ads to finance directors at companies with 50 to 200 employees in Texas, something Google and Meta cannot do as precisely.

The trade-off is cost. If your average sale is small, the same budget will usually go further on Google or Meta. Our guide to [Facebook ads vs Google ads](https://www.clarieo.com/insights/facebook-ads-vs-google-ads-small-business) covers those platforms.

02

## How much do LinkedIn ads cost in 2026?

Expect most clicks to cost over $10. A 2026 study of 211 B2B advertisers found a median CPC of $13.23 for single image ads.

![A table of median LinkedIn cost per click by ad format](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F2n9frivv%2Fproduction%2Fc26e8059297e3f1ba181328ebd2cb4fa3fc1431b-2800x1750.jpg%3Fw%3D1400%26q%3D90%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

The most useful recent data comes from ZenABM, which analysed 161,256 ads from 211 B2B companies, with $5.5 million in spend, published in February 2026. It reported median costs by ad format, shown in the table below. For US audiences it reported a median CPM of $62.67.

Your costs will differ by industry, audience size and ad quality. Treat these as a starting point, not a quote.

### Median LinkedIn ad costs, ZenABM, Feb 2026

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |Median LinkedIn ad costs, ZenABM, Feb 2026
| Metric | Median CPC | Median CPM | Median CTR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single image | Median CPC$13.23 | Median CPM$59.15 | Median CTR0.42% |
| Carousel | Median CPC$13.30 | Median CPM$45.28 | Median CTR0.32% |
| Video | Median CPC$15.61 | Median CPM$38.94 | Median CTR0.24% |
| Thought Leader Ad | Median CPC$2.29 | Median CPM$49.37 | Median CTR2.68% |

03

## What is the minimum budget for LinkedIn ads?

LinkedIn's minimum is $10 a day, or $100 for a new lifetime budget. A useful test usually needs much more.

![An example: $1,500 a month buys about 113 clicks and about 11 leads](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F2n9frivv%2Fproduction%2Fc7544bd45785387b81137c61722e43fedf127205-2800x1750.jpg%3Fw%3D1400%26q%3D90%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

LinkedIn's own guidance says the minimum daily budget is $10 for any ad format, and the minimum lifetime budget for a new campaign is $100. Campaign Manager suggests $25 a day by default for new advertisers.

Here is why minimum budgets disappoint. At a $13 cost per click, $10 a day buys fewer than one click a day. A month of $1,500 buys about 113 clicks. If 10% of those people fill in a Lead Gen Form, which is roughly the average ZenABM reported, that is about 11 leads at around $135 each.

Decide whether that cost per lead works for your business before you spend anything.

04

## When LinkedIn ads make sense for a small business

They work best when your buyer has a clear job title, the deal is valuable and you can follow up quickly.

![A list of five signs LinkedIn ads suit a small business](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F2n9frivv%2Fproduction%2F7e3100a7413080348de991e13478a02e4054e3ee-2800x1750.jpg%3Fw%3D1400%26q%3D90%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

Typical winners are consultancies, agencies, software companies, recruiters, accountants and specialist suppliers. In each case, one client can pay back months of ad spend.

If your buyers are consumers, or you cannot say which job titles buy from you, start elsewhere. Our guide on [whether Google Ads are worth it](https://www.clarieo.com/insights/google-ads-worth-it-small-business) is a better first read.

> On LinkedIn you pay for precision. It only pays back when each customer is worth it.

05

## LinkedIn ads vs Facebook and Google ads

Google catches people already searching, Meta reaches large audiences cheaply and LinkedIn reaches decision-makers by job.

## Quick Summary

[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fgrowth.cx%2Fblog%2Flinkedln-advertising-costs-b2b-saas%2F)[](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgrowth.cx%2Fblog%2Flinkedln-advertising-costs-b2b-saas%2F)

In 2026, LinkedIn advertising costs are driven by audience targeting and bidding strategy, with average CPCs ranging from $5 to $8 and CPMs between $6 and $10. High competition in SaaS and B2B drives up costs, but advertisers can control spend by improving ad relevance and using Lead Gen Forms to reach decision-makers more effectively.

In 2026, **LinkedIn** advertising remains a key player for businesses, especially in industries like SaaS and B2B. 

With over 1 billion members worldwide and around [310 million monthly active users](https://socialrails.com/blog/linkedin-demographics-complete-guide), LinkedIn offers powerful targeting to reach decision makers at scale. This makes the platform especially effective for [lead generation](https://growth.cx/blog/lead-generation-process/), provided budgets are planned strategically.

According to recent [Marketing LTB statistics](https://marketingltb.com/blog/statistics/linkedin-ads-statistics/#:~:text=84%25%20of%20marketers%20plan%20to,email%20marketing%20for%20better%20conversion.), LinkedIn is the highest-ROI social platform for 65% of B2B marketers. Knowing the costs, from clicks to leads, allows businesses to refine their strategies and maximize their returns. 

This blog breaks down LinkedIn advertising costs and pricing trends, so SaaS and B2B teams can plan campaigns with clarity and confidence.

## What Are the Main Types of LinkedIn Ads and How Do They Impact Advertising Costs?

LinkedIn offers several types of ads, each with its own pricing structure and effectiveness.

![Different Types of LinkedIn Ads - Sponsored Content, Text Ads, InMail Ads, Dynamic Ads,s and Carousel Ads](https://growth.cx/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Different-Types-of-LinkedIn-Ads-Sponsored-Content-Text-Ads-InMail-Ads-Dynamic-Adss-and-Carousel-Ads-1024x576.webp)

### 1\. Sponsored Content

*   **Description:** These are native ads that appear directly in users’ feeds, blending seamlessly with organic content.  
    
*   **LinkedIn Ads Pricing Impact:** Sponsored Content typically incurs higher costs due to its premium placement and its effectiveness in driving engagement. CPC (cost-per-click) and CPM (cost-per-mille) are commonly used pricing models.  
    
*   **Best for:** LinkedIn Ads for B2B and LinkedIn Ads for SaaS, as they allow businesses to target specific industries and decision-makers effectively.  
    

### 2\. Text Ads

*   **Description:** Small ads consisting of a short headline, description, and a thumbnail image, usually placed on the right sidebar of LinkedIn’s desktop version.  
    
*   **LinkedIn Ads Pricing Impact:** Text Ads are generally more affordable than Sponsored Content, with a pay-per-click (PPC) model.  
    
*   **Best for:** [SaaS marketing agencies](https://growth.cx/blog/full-service-saas-marketing-agency/) or businesses with smaller budgets looking for cost-effective LinkedIn advertising options.  
    

### 3\. InMail Ads

*   **Description:** These are direct messages sent to a user’s inbox, appearing similar to an email but within LinkedIn.  
    
*   **LinkedIn Ads Pricing Impact:** InMail ads can be more expensive due to their personalized nature and high engagement rate. The cost is typically calculated per send or per click.  
    
*   **Best for:** Businesses looking to target decision-makers, making it ideal for LinkedIn Ads for B2B.  
    

### 4\. Dynamic Ads

*   **Description:** These are personalized ads that dynamically change based on the user’s profile, such as showing their profile image or name.  
    
*   **LinkedIn Ads Pricing Impact:** Dynamic Ads usually have a higher cost per impression (CPI) due to their ability to personalize and improve engagement.  
    
*   **Best for:** Brands with a strong visual presence, or those aiming for more personalized experiences in their LinkedIn Ads for [SaaS marketing campaigns](https://growth.cx/blog/saas-marketing-campaigns-and-outcomes/).  
    

### 5\. Carousel Ads

*   **Description:** Carousel ads allow you to display multiple images or videos that users can scroll through.  
    
*   **LinkedIn Ads Pricing Impact:** Carousel ads can drive higher engagement but typically come with a higher price tag compared to static image ads due to their interactive nature.  
    
*   **Best for:** LinkedIn Ads for B2B that need to showcase multiple products or services in a single campaign.

### **How Much Does LinkedIn Advertising Cost in 2026?**

When evaluating LinkedIn advertising cost in India, pricing is influenced by audience seniority, industry competition, and bidding strategy, making costs slightly more variable than global averages.
